justification: Inspected byte-buddy-maven-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/maven/Initialization.java, CoordinateConfiguration.java, ByteBuddyMojo.java, and InitializationTest.java. Initialization is a small 82-line configuration class with only 2 fields, 1 constructor, and 1 behavior method (`getEntryPoint`); its single responsibility is resolving an EntryPoint, while coordinate resolution is delegated to the superclass `CoordinateConfiguration`. The tests cover the defaulting and resolution paths, and there is no evidence of large size, many methods, or multiple low-cohesion responsibilities that would indicate insufficient modularization.
